Capture native R scientific reproducibility with optional frozen Python source attestation

etr_capture_environment.Rd

Scientific reproducibility environment capture using actual R interpreter, platform, package version and numerical thread settings. This is a native-R source-scientific purpose analogue of the frozen Python 1.2 capture_environment export, not a Python interpreter capture, not a Python package distribution inventory and not a Python-native backend object. Optional genuine Python source environment records can be validated and paired for auditing without invoking Python. The default return shape remains unchanged.

Usage

etr_capture_environment(strict_source_record = FALSE,
  python_source_snapshot = NULL)

Arguments

strict_source_record

FALSE (default) preserves the original native R environment record. TRUE builds a source-scientific R-versus-Python reproducibility schema crosswalk without importing or running a Python interpreter.

python_source_snapshot

Optional genuine independently captured Python 1.2 eyetrajectoriespy.capture_environment() record. It must match the eight version-one frozen source fields and all nested interpreter, platform, dependency, optional backend and thread names exactly. A source snapshot is never fabricated and is accepted only when strict_source_record=TRUE.

Value

By default a named, version-one native R runtime and installed R package reproducibility record. Under strict source mode a etr_native_environment_scientific_record with separately measured native R facts, the exact frozen Python 1.2 environment schema crosswalk, an optional validated externally captured Python source environment, and explicit full-source difference/certification flags.

Details

The frozen Python capture reports interpreter version, implementation, executable, operating system/platform, package and Git commit, versions of six Python dependencies and three optional backend packages, UTC time and four numerical thread environment variables. Native R records corresponding actual R runtime, OS and R dependency facts. Source Python dependency versions remain unknown to the native R capture unless a genuine external Python source snapshot is provided. No full Python-runtime source parity or independent scientific source certification is claimed. See docs/native-reproducibility-source-environment-20261112.md.
